invariants.rationale: The method always returns a List<V> using Collectors.toList(), which never returns null.
The stream pipeline is executed on 'data', so it must be non-null at method exit.
The reduction groups input pairs by key; number of unique keys is at most the number of input elements.
Parallelism is expected to be positive for proper parallel execution.
If result is empty, then the input data must also have been empty, otherwise grouping will yield at least one key.
